features.name: Interactive Oil Pan Diagram
features.acceptance: Tapping a hotspot (or its list row) opens a sheet for that part, e.g. the oil pan gasket shows MD030133, description, image placeholder, and working Shopee + Lazada search links. Works on a 375px-wide phone.

features.name: Price & Newest Sort
features.acceptance: User can sort parts by price (low → high) or newest; the choice also applies to generated Shopee/FB Marketplace links (and Lazada price sort).

features.name: Preferred Location Selector
features.acceptance: On first visit the user picks a preferred area (Quezon City / NCR, Region 1, Baguio, ...) or uses browser geolocation; the choice persists and is shown in the header.

features.name: 3D Category Explorer
features.acceptance: Home lists all 23 MegaZip categories (123 diagrams). Each category page shows a simple 3D model that can be rotated and zoomed (pinch, scroll, +/- buttons); tapping a part or its list row shows that diagram's data, seeded OEM parts where available, and Shopee/Lazada/FB search links. Works on a 375px-wide phone.
